name: Transient Photon Beams
aliases: progressive transient path tracing with temporal KDE (PTPT) comparison target
definition: A numerical solution for rendering participating media in transient state that extends the steady-state Photon Beams algorithm by accounting for photon time-of-flight along continuous beam trajectories, using 2D density estimation to mitigate variance.
summary: Transient Photon Beams renders participating media in the transient state by combining photon beam tracing with 2D density estimation to preserve full directional and temporal light transport structure.
